review_notes: I reviewed the whole supplied file (lines 1–69) against the repeated-proof-machinery rubric. It has two theorems. The first, `subgroup_eq_bot_or_eq_or_eq_top_of_card_eq_two`, does a divisor case split and then three short dispatches. The second, `card_subgroups_of_card_eq_four`, builds H = zpowers (g^2) and then proves `hHbot`, `hHtop` and `hbt`. Each of those three is a one- to three-line `simp` argument that compares cardinalities. They look alike, but each is a short calculation, so a shared lemma would not reduce the proof effort enough to meet the rubric's bar. Nothing else is repeated between the two theorems. I did not read other files or search Mathlib for replacements, because no repeated block was substantial enough to need one. The one remaining uncertainty is that merging `hHbot`, `hHtop` and `hbt` into a single cardinality-based distinctness lemma might read a little tidier. I judged that to be a marginal change.
